definitions.explanation: The invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth.
The pervading tone or mood of a place or situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気|くうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: The air in the room is bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧{空気|くうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}えよう→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's open the window and air out the room.

examples.japanese: {空気|くうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}かった→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: The atmosphere at the meeting was tense.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: That person can never read the room, so everyone has a hard time.

notes:
{空気|くうき} has both a physical meaning (air) and an abstract meaning (atmosphere, mood).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {空気|くうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the room (sense unspoken mood)
- {空気|くうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}える→入れ替える：08227_irekaeru⟧: to air out (a room)
- {空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: the air is bad / the atmosphere is awkward
- {空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧: heavy atmosphere (tense)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{空気|くうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ is an important Japanese concept. Someone who fails to read the room may be called KY ({空気|くうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧, can't read the air).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: atmosphere, ambiance (more for places/settings)
- ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧: atmosphere (scientific/meteorological)
